answers.core: It's a shortcut.  I'm sure you could write a plugin to provide a shortcut for the button but it would be a misuse of a plugin I think.
answers.workaround: I'd use it a lot.  I made it through about 40 minutes of searching for a solution which should underscore how important I think this shortcut is.  I've already spent more time researching and creating this issue than I'll ever spend moving the mouse to the button to click it.
